frames.frame: [S V ...], and/or [助动词/情态词]（独用）
frames.gloss: 助动词后省去与前文相同的谓语，只剩 do/will/can 等回指前文动作。
frames.notes: 勿把助动词当完整谓语，省略回指前句

examples.text: And it should: Wasted time is a drag on Americans' economic and private lives, not to mention infuriating.

frames.gloss: 与其说重在A，不如说重在B——重心后置的取舍对照。
frames.notes: 非程度比较，是重心对照

examples.text: Curriculums - from grammar school to college - should evolve to focus less on memorizing facts and more on creativity and complex communication.

College officials tend to emphasize that the goal of grade forgiveness is less about the grade itself and more about encouraging students to retake courses critical to their degree program and graduation without incurring a big penalty.

frames.gloss: the way 后省略 that/in which，直接跟句子作方式宾语。
frames.notes: way 后无关系词，勿另找宾语

examples.text: That misses the way the surveillance economy works.

frames.related: The [抽象N] is that [S V]（表语从句）

examples.text: Part of the issue is that the government did not anticipate the steep increase in airline travel, so the TSA is now rushing to get new screeners on the line.
Part of the issue is that airports have only so much room for screening lanes.
Another factor may be that more people are trying to overpack their carry-on bags to avoid checked baggage fees, though the airlines strongly dispute this.

frames.gloss: 关系从句里嵌入报道动词，that 兼作从句主语，真正谓语在 said/felt 之后。
frames.notes: 易把 said/felt 当从句终点而读断

examples.text: After the first installment, Dickens wrote to the artist and asked him to correct a drawing Dickens felt was not faithful enough to his prose.
